_meta.description: Amazon Ads Sponsored Products per campaign per marketplace-local day (Reporting v3 spCampaigns). Retired: v3 report collection stopped for every store on 2026-11-20; Ads data from 2026-09-01 is in v_ads_campaign_daily (ad_product = 'Sponsored Products'), and this table is deleted on 2026-12-31.
_meta.retention_note: rows older than 730 days are pruned nightly (newest snapshot per store never pruned where applicable); query beyond the window returns a report_date_note
caveats: For any day from 2026-09-01 read v_ads_campaign_daily with ad_product = 'Sponsored Products'; use this table only for days before 2026-09-01, until it is deleted on 2026-12-31. Split a range at 2026-09-01 and never add the two: the same Ads data is in both.

Columns there: campaign_name, campaign_status → campaign_state, campaign_budget_amount (Sponsored Brands and Display: campaign_budget) → campaign_budget, campaign_budget_type and portfolio_id there are the campaign's CURRENT values. cost and spend → total_cost; impressions and clicks as named; purchases_7d → purchases, sales_7d → sales, units_sold_clicks_7d → units_sold_from_clicks, purchases_same_sku_7d → purchases_promoted, attributed_sales_same_sku_7d → sales_promoted, units_sold_same_sku_7d → units_sold_promoted. Stream keeps one attribution window per row (attribution_window_days: 7 for a seller's Sponsored Products, 14 for a vendor's, whose 14-day columns map the same way); the 1- and 30-day columns have no Stream twin. cost_per_click, click_through_rate, ACOS and ROAS are not stored: compute them from the sums. currency_code → currency.
Its rows stop on 2026-11-20, when v3 collection ended for every store (its schedules read superseded_by_stream): its newest day is not the newest Ads data.

columns.note: Marketplace this ads row belongs to. Query ads data per (store, country_code) directly — no need to reverse-map profile_id.
Internal tenant scope — auto-applied from `store`; never filter on it manually.
Ads profile id (one per marketplace) — auto-filtered from the store suffix; do not filter manually.

Row ingest timestamp (UTC). Bookkeeping, not business data. UTC instant (timestamptz). Query results show it in the store ref's marketplace local time, without an offset; a bare date in a filter is that marketplace's midnight.
JSON of Amazon columns with no dedicated DB column (unmapped/new headers land here).
